verdict.rationale: Brex's first-party pages describe in-product AI that produces suggestions and insights from account data. Brex AI suggests the matching PO and drafts payments, an audit agent categorizes potential expense violations by risk level, and AI assistants write memos and offer policy help. All of this evidence is vendor marketing copy and focuses on workflow automation rather than broader analytical insight. Missing for 10: evidence of analytical spend insights or recommendations (e.g., trends, savings opportunities), in-depth product docs on the AI features, independent or hands-on corroboration.
